newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER ROUT JUVENTUS 3-0 IN ITALIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER ROUT JUVENTUS 3-0 IN ITALIAN CUP.

text.p: Serie A leaders Inter Milan got sweet revenge on Wednesday when they humiliated European champions Juventus 3-0 in the first leg of their Italian Cup quarter-final.
Inter, recently beaten 2-0 by Juventus in the league, had come to Turin's Delle Alpi stadium wondering if they would undergo yet another soccer lesson from their illustrious hosts.
But apart from a few early chances, like when Alessandro Del Piero hit the bar with a fierce blast minutes into the match, the game belonged to Inter.
English coach Roy Hodgson's side dominated largely thanks to an inspired Paul Ince, who had missed the league loss to Juventus through suspension.

The England international provided muscle in the midfield and then sealed victory by heading home the second goal in the 77th minute after Chile marksman Ivan Zamorano had put Inter on top with a goal in the 33rd.
France playmaker Youri Djorkaeff turned the win into a rout with a close-range goal just before time.
Juventus will need a near-miracle to avoid elimination from the tournament they won in 1995 when they travel to Milan for the second leg on November 27.
Elsewhere, two goals from Sweden striker Kennet Andersson powered Bologna to a 3-1 away victory over second division Cremonese in their first leg quarter-final clash.
